text:
## 1. Launch email
Hi [First name],

You know the moment. The case is solved, the report looks great, you hit **["Open in mail"]** - and from there the conversation happens somewhere else. Your inbox, your phone, a calendar invite, a text. Three weeks later you're rebuilding the story before you call back.

So we fixed it. Meet **[Client Conversations]**: starting [date], your Annuities Genius CRM keeps the whole conversation on the case.

- **Email from the case.** Send the report and the follow-up from your own address. Every email is saved on the case, and [replies land next to it].
- **Calls, texts, and meetings from the case.** Call from your computer. Text any client - not only website leads - [from your own number]. Send your booking link; the meeting and its reminder land on the case. All of it is saved on the case automatically.
- **Follow-ups that don't slip.** GrantAI's follow-up plan [becomes dated reminders on the case], each drafted by GrantAI from the illustration you sent and your call notes. Edit it, send it, or skip it - nothing goes to a client without your click.
- **One Client Profile, one timeline.** The timeline you already have - reports, illustrations, the E-App - now shows every email, call, and text next to them, dated.
- [Agents on an IMO's Enterprise account only] **Case Design with the whole story.** Click Request Case Design as you do today and [pick the emails and call notes that go with it] - [IMO name]'s desk designs for what the client actually asked. Nothing changes in the tools [IMO name] gives you.

**Getting started.** Every client you've quoted in Annuities Genius is already here.
1. Connect your email once - email and meetings work right away.
2. Pick a local number and start calling right away - or [bring your office line over].
3. Texting from your own number switches on after the registration every US business texting line needs - [we file it for you].

Already on Redtail or Wealthbox? Keep them for your book - bring any contact in with one click, as you do today.

**You stay in control:**
- [Texts go only to clients who've said yes, and a STOP reply ends texting to them automatically.]
- [Call recording is off unless you turn it on.]
- [Email and meetings come with every plan.] Calls and texts: [N minutes and N texts a month included, then $X a minute and $Y a text].
- [Your clients and their conversations are never used for marketing or lead generation, and never sold.]
- [Your clients, messages, and recordings export any time; nothing is held back if you leave.]

**Where to find it:** open any client → Case → **[Client Conversations]**.

See one client go from first lead to E-App, live: **Wednesday, [date], 11 AM PT / 1 PM CT / 2 PM ET**.

**[Save My Seat]**

Questions? Give us a call at 949-600-7707 - [a person picks up].
